The functional epitope of mAb 4E11 on DENV-1 DIII was determined by combinatorial alanine scanning detected by phage ELISA. The contact residues previously determined by structural analysis were chosen for analysis. Two residues on DENV-1 DIII were “hot spot” positions, K310 on the A-strand and L387 on the G-strand. Residues L389 and W391 on the G-strand contributed less significantly but together with K310 and L387 form a nearly contiguous and mostly hydrophobic core epitope. In addition, P332, which was not a direct contact residue but appeared to possibly play a supporting structural role, was strongly preferred in DENV-1, -2, and -3. MAb 4E11 recognized a conserved, core functional epitope comprised of K310, L/I387, L389, and W391 in DENV-1, -2, -3, and -4.
